Signs of the World

Wi-Fi

History

The name Wi-Fi was coined in 1999 by the brand consultancy Interbrand, which the Wi-Fi Alliance hired to find something catchier than "IEEE 802.11b Direct Sequence." It was picked from a list of ten names. Despite the "Wireless Fidelity" slogan the Alliance briefly used, it is disputed whether the name stands for anything.

Adoption

The fan of arcs signals a wireless connection on devices around the world, with each maker drawing its own version.
